title: A Self-Improving Agent that Grows its Own DSL: Oracle-Free Operator Induction for Exact Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.20809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A self-improving agent has to decide which new skills to keep, and in practice it keeps whatever earns a high reward, convinces a judge model, or compresses its library, even when the skill is wrong. That is fine until the answers have to be exactly right: over a table of transactions, a total is either right or wrong. We ask a harder question: can an agent grow what it can compute with no reward, no judge, and no answer key, and still be exactly right? A single frozen model runs two nested loops over a small, exact domain-specific language (DSL). The inner loop answers new questions only when two independently written expressions agree on every record. The outer loop discovers its own missing capability and authors an operator for it, admitted only when an independent second implementation agrees and the result obeys a conservation law, all without ground truth. translated_title: 一个自行扩展领域特定语言的自改进智能体：面向精确问答的无Oracle算子归纳
translated_abstract: 一个自改进智能体必须决定保留哪些新技能，而在实践中，它保留的往往是任何能获得高奖励、说服评判模型或压缩其技能库的技能——即使该技能是错误的。当答案必须完全正确时，这种方式就行不通了：在一张交易数据表中，总额要么正确要么错误。我们提出了一个更难的问题：智能体能否在没有奖励信号、没有评判模型、没有答案密钥的情况下扩展其可计算能力，并且仍然做到完全正确？一个单一的冻结模型在一个小型、精确的领域特定语言（DSL）上运行两个嵌套循环。内循环只有在两个独立编写的表达式对每条记录都得出一致结果时才回答新问题。外循环自行发现其缺失的能力并为之编写一个算子，只有当独立的第二实现与之一致且结果遵守守恒定律时，该算子才被接纳——所有这些都不需要真实标签。内循环大约将可回答问题的集合扩大了三倍，而外循环……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种无需奖励、评判模型或答案密钥的自改进智能体，通过双层嵌套循环在自生成的DSL上实现精确问答——内循环以双独立表达式一致性验证答案，外循环借助独立第二实现与守恒定律无监督地归纳新算子，使可回答问题集合约扩大三倍。
en_tdlr: A self-improving agent grows its own DSL without any reward, judge, or ground truth, using an inner loop that answers questions only when two independently written expressions agree and an outer loop that induces new operators verified by an independent second implementation and conservation laws, roughly tripling the set of exactly answerable questions.
